brief:
Four people were killed during a family quarrel in Silwan, a neighborhood in occupied East Jerusalem, according to Maan Wire. The deaths occurred as a result of escalating tensions within the family, though specific details about what prompted the violent confrontation remain unclear.

The incident marks another instance of deadly internal conflict in the densely populated Palestinian neighborhood. Authorities have not yet released further information about the identities of those killed, the nature of the dispute, or whether any arrests have been made in connection with the deaths.
title: Four people killed in family dispute in Jerusalem's Silwan neighborhood
